name: Mishu
dates: Born with love  ·  Wrapped in wings
story: She was a true foodie at heart, with a special love for all things chatpata! Her face would light up with absolute joy whenever chicken lollipop was around—we would open our mouth wide and go 'Aaa, aaa!', and she’d match our excitement every single time.

When Meshika didn't like something or wanted to show off her funny, naughty side, she made the best faces—playfully rolling her eyes and completely ignoring us with a mischievous little smile. She lit up every room the moment she walked in.
All it took was calling out 'Miguuuuuuuuu!'and she would burst into the sweetest, hardest laughter that echoed through the whole house and melted everyone's heart.
